description: This file defines the OrganizationModel class in the OrangeHRM Admin API module. It implements the Normalizable interface and includes traits for serialization. The class is used to create a model representation of the Organization entity for API responses, specifying properties like name, registration number, contact details, address, and notes.

classes.description: Model class for representing an Organization in the API, implementing serialization and normalization capabilities.
